messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] 502 errors
parts:
Hi,

Thank you for reporting this. I corrected the problem with your app returning a 502. Applications will automatically go to sleep when they are not in use, however they are supposed to wake up when requested. However your application was mis-configured because of a problem on our end. I've corrected the problem so you should not see the 502 error after the application goes to sleep. 

Thanks!

-Andy
